Hiller Aviation Museum 紧邻 San Carlos Air: Beside San Carlos Airport, Hiller Aviation Museum makes familiar aircraft easier to understand. Build your visit around three questions: how wings carry weight, how pilots see, and why aircraft have different shapes. You need no knowledge of model names. The museum is the main destination; active airport areas are outside this route.

第一站：主展厅看飞机轮廓: Stop 1: aircraft shapes in the main gallery
入馆先问当天哪些机舱或活动开放，再挑一架直升机和一架固定翼飞机比较。带孩子时让他: Ask which cockpits and activities are available, then compare a helicopter with a fixed-wing aircraft. Children can look for rotors, wings and landing gear before reading labels. Keep wheelchairs and strollers to one side when stopping so others can pass.
第二站：早期飞行与客机展陈: Stop 2: early flight and airliner exhibits
沿导览图挑早期飞行与客机展陈各看一段，留意材料、座舱视野和控制装置的变化。客机机: Use the guide to select early-flight and airliner displays, comparing materials, visibility and controls. Follow on-site rules for cockpit and nose-section access. Exterior views still offer useful details; skip a queue and revisit a favorite aircraft if that suits your group.
第三站：互动加选与返程集合: Stop 3: an optional activity and departure
最后按当天开放和排队情况选择一个互动项目；预约、年龄要求和额外费用先向工作人员问: Choose one activity according to availability and queues, checking reservations, age limits and extra fees with staff. Tired children can revisit a favorite display instead. Regroup at the entrance before leaving for food, and allow time to reach the station before your return train.
带娃把一轮观察控制得短一些，每人选一架最想记住的飞机，比拍完所有展品更容易保持兴: Keep observation sessions short with children and let each person choose one aircraft to remember. On rainy days, focus on indoor exhibits and bring a layer for pickup. Review walking directions and road crossings before using the station route, or arrange a pickup point.
